info.name: Adobe Experience Cloud Adobe Analytics 2.0 Activities Report Suites API
Adobe Analytics Adobe Experience Cloud List Report Suites

params.name: companyId
params.description: The global company ID for the Analytics account.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of report suites available to the authenticated user within the specified company. Each entry includes the report suite ID, name, and configuration metadata.

info.name: Adobe Analytics Adobe Experience Cloud Get a Report Suite

items.docs: Retrieves the configuration details for a single report suite identified by its report suite ID (rsid). Returns metadata including the name, currency, timezone, and enabled features.
